name: Combat Zone
description:
Experience thrilling tank operations and infantry close combat rendered in breathtaking graphics! Take control of captured tanks and armored vehicles on the battlefield and crush enemy positions with 120mm main guns. Or, take up an RPG-7 anti-tank rocket launcher and destroy enemy tanks with a single shot! This dynamic combination of infantry and tanks provides an unprecedented battlefield experience. Set against a scorching desert backdrop, choose from four different classes and enjoy the strategic gameplay.

・Use tanks as both transportation and attack platforms! Experience the innovative combination of tank piloting and RPG-7 anti-tank assaults.
・High-quality, realistic open-field battlefield graphics showcase decisive battles of steel versus steel.
・Whether you board tanks for direct control and crush enemy positions with 120mm main guns, or shoulder RPG-7 anti-tank rockets to obliterate steel war machines with a single strike, it's entirely up to you!
・There are four classes: Assault, Support, Engineer, and Recon. Each class has unique special weapons and tactics, enabling diverse combat styles.
・Ultra-high-definition graphics and 3D sound realistically reproduce the roar of tank engines, the explosion of RPG-7s, and even the sound of a sandstorm.
・Intuitive aiming and controls allow both novice and expert players to enjoy tank piloting and anti-tank attacks.
・Spectacular realism! Experience the weight of tanks and the explosive impact of weapons through 3D physics engines.
・A variety of game modes are available.
・Take on "Combat Zone" missions as part of the world's elite special forces!

Open battlefields, swept by sandstorms, come to life with photorealistic graphics. Experience 120mm artillery strikes from tank cockpits, RPG-7 anti-tank attacks, and strategic battles using the special weapons of four classes. Cutting-edge rendering technology provides an unparalleled, immersive experience. Experience the ultimate desert battlefield FPS game with steel tanks!

Synopsis
An endless wasteland, scorched by the sun and covered in golden sand, stretches out before you. Deep underground, the "Ultima Crystal," the ultimate energy source, pulses with an eerie heartbeat. The mega-corporation Kronos Industries deploys its heavily armored tank battalion, the "Iron Hammer," to the front lines in an attempt to monopolize high-purity crystals and fortify mining installations. Refinement towers belch black smoke, and thundering artillery shakes the earth.

In response, the United Nations dispatches an elite force comprising four classes Assault, Support, Engineer, and Recon to counter this threat. You step onto the battlefield as one of them.

Take control of frontline tanks and dominate the battlefield with your artillery. Alternatively, shoulder an RPG-7 to obliterate enemy tanks in a single strike and send pillars of fire into the desert. Will you command steel tanks or shatter steel armor? Your actions in the heat of battle will determine its fate.
